selection: windows qualifying in every structure are intersected, enumerated in residue order, then sampled at even spacing; deterministic, no seed

prespecified_test.stated: before the enlarged background was run
prespecified_test.hypothesis: ligand-associated response localises to the Switch-II contact module, so both Frag-B and Frag-F rank first among their length-matched disjoint neutral background
prespecified_test.statistic: product of per-fragment rank-one probabilities, 1/(n_background+1) each
prespecified_test.why_joint: the manuscript's claim is about the module, not about either fragment alone; testing them together is the claim's own form and not a combination chosen after seeing which fragment did better
prespecified_test.why_disjoint: overlapping windows share most of their residues and are not independent observations; a background of overlapping windows would make the rank statistic look stronger than the data support
prespecified_test.hard_limit: KRAS is about 167 residues, and after excluding the P-loop, both switches and every study fragment there is not room for more disjoint long windows. No amount of additional compute lowers the per-fragment floor.
prespecified_test.negative_result_action: if either Switch-II fragment fails to rank first, the localisation claim is not supported by this control and is removed
